_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA island. Height 0 here = the grass surface = hub y -3: place each mesh at hub (center.x, center.y - 3, center.z). CleanIsland_Rim replaces the edge of Grass + Frosting; CleanIsland_Under replaces IslandRock x6. The flat Grass part (cylinder radius 99, top at y = -3) stays; the rim rolls over its edge.

CleanIsland_Rim.note: white bumper lip rolling over the grass edge, sky-blue band

CleanIsland_Under.note: four soft tiers of white rock and pale stone, rounded tip

CleanIsland_Crystal.material: SmoothPlastic (SurfaceAppearance) (or Glass / Neon tint for sparkle)
CleanIsland_Crystal.note: 6 clusters of pastel crystals growing out of the ledges; flat-shaded on purpose

CleanIsland_Glow.note: thin light line round the whole rim
